turns.in: how much is the chicken & cheese sub?
turns.comment: Asking a price used to PUT THE ITEM IN THE CART and charge for it. findDirectMatches runs before the AI and only substring-matches an item name anywhere in the text, so no prompt wording could have prevented it -- isItemQuestion() has to catch the question ahead of the direct matcher. Asserted on the cart rather than the reply wording because the answer itself is AI-generated: this stays true even in CI, where there is no Gemini key and the call fails.
The control that matters: the guard must not eat REAL orders. A question filter that also blocks ordering would be a worse bug than the one it fixed.
